## Objective

Make aggregate health, exits and freshness agree with selected required scope.

## Scope

- Core/memory/advanced health
- Guard and workbench assessment
- Derived invalidation and authorized maintenance closure
- Cause-specific fault controls

## Entry conditions

- SHACL failure semantics and memory evidence compatibility are established.

## Exit criteria

- Every diagnostic fault has meaningful aggregate/detail/exit and no-write coverage; maintenance authority and dependencies are explicit.

## Risks

- Preserve exact current inputs, project ownership and operation-specific authority; a failed required criterion blocks phase acceptance.

- Retain existing detailed result information for consumers and document any intentional field/exit transition.

- Required selected stale/missing/invalid generated state changes primary health and exit status consistently; canonical lookup readiness remains separately visible.
- Never-built optional projections and neutral disabled capabilities are labeled according to the selected assessment scope.
- Results include assessment identity/time/version context and safe next-operation diagnostics without writes.

### Risks

- Do not disable evidence validation or count lexical availability as selected semantic runtime readiness.

### Acceptance criteria

- Selected unavailable backend, stale certification or unsupported current claim cannot be masked by status ready and exit zero.
- Historical support/applicability detail remains accurate; absent requested memory differs from intentionally disabled optional backend.
- Health neither starts vendor runtime nor repairs index/projection/evidence; lexical limitations remain visible.

### Planned verification

- Run nested evidence/backend fault controls and verify aggregate, details and exit code.
- Check read preservation and explicit unsupported historical/current distinctions against TASK-010 fixtures.

### Risks

- Reusing enabled=true or a constant coverage label would preserve the defect.
- Changed guard-owned helpers invalidate existing bindings and must enter the exact adoption/repair sequence.

### Acceptance criteria

- All eight declared guard families and the current adapter set are checked against actual bootstrap, engine, contract and required backend inputs.
- Missing, incomplete, changed or mismatched binding/certification makes a required selected component non-ready and the aggregate/exit nonzero.
- Integrity, backend certification, actual dispatch coverage and unexercised behavior remain distinct; no production write is dispatched by inspection.

### Planned verification

- Inject missing/mismatched adapter, bootstrap, engine and backend inputs and inspect primary/nested/CLI outcomes.
- Run existing guard coverage and authority controls using audit-owned fixtures; retain no-write comparisons.

## TASK-015 - Implement bounded workbench service assessment

Provide a bounded read-only probe of an explicitly selected loopback workbench and distinguish installed/on-demand capability from actual matched service state.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-005, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-010, REQ-011 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_workbench.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_advanced_cli.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_workbench_security.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-002, TASK-014 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Do not probe arbitrary network destinations or reuse another project session as readiness proof.

### Acceptance criteria

- Running requires a successful safe service response with matching project identity; stopped, unreachable, wrong-project and not-assessed states are explicit.
- Health starts no service and persists no credentials; an independently authorized audit-owned probe/service records execution and cleanup.
- A valid neutral/on-demand capability remains supported without imposing continuous service.

### Planned verification

- Exercise matched running, stopped, wrong-project, unreachable and not-selected loopback cases.
- Verify read-only operations, bounded timeout, private ephemeral credential handling and owned-process cleanup.

Make dependency sets and invalidation checks explicit across memory projection/index/certification and ontology compile/wiki/memory-link/semantic products without enabling read-time repair.

| Status | `planned` |

| Parallel group | None |

### Risks

- Overbroad invalidation can create a refresh cycle; missed dependencies can certify stale data.

### Acceptance criteria

- README/document, memory lifecycle/content, ontology helper/definition, profile and model/index changes invalidate exactly the affected required products.
- Missing, modified or stale previously required products cannot appear current; stale associations are excluded and supported lexical fallback remains labeled.

### Planned verification

- Change each declared input class in isolated fixtures and verify the affected product states and safe fallback.
- Verify irrelevant input changes do not fabricate dependencies and read checks preserve bytes/mtimes.

## TASK-017 - Close derived maintenance within authorized mutations

Extend existing publication/maintenance/refresh completion checks to evaluate final dependency versions, refresh in granted order, or report precise pending work and recovery without broadening authority.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-007, REQ-011, REQ-015, REQ-016, REQ-017 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/memory/scripts/memory_maintenance.py, SKILLS-depo/memory/scripts/memory_publish.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_publication.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_profiles.py, Verification/ontology-health-repairs/maintenance-order.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-011, TASK-016 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Publication evidence and generated readiness have different durable owners; avoid a second ledger.

### Acceptance criteria

- Each relevant authorized operation accounts for invalidated required products using final inputs; source implementation is distinct from live restoration in TASK-029.
- Missing maintenance scope, interrupted work or unavailable prerequisites yields truthful pending/stale completion with the exact next route.
- No read acquires repair authority, no hidden daemon is added, and existing journal/ownership contracts remain authoritative.

### Planned verification

- Run mutation-scope, no-maintenance-scope and interrupted refresh controls against declared dependencies.
- Verify refreshed outputs are rechecked after final writes and current readiness is not inherited from an earlier receipt.

### Risks

- A test that stops at path validation cannot establish a downstream diagnostic correction.

### Acceptance criteria

- Healthy baselines, absent/invalid config, missing/stale/invalid products, changed evidence/source, unavailable backend, stale certificate/index, incomplete guard, stopped/wrong-project service, timeout/cancellation and disabled profiles are covered.
- Every control demonstrates its intended injected cause, asserts aggregate/detail/CLI result, and preserves read-only fixture bytes/mtimes.
- Path-precondition errors, synthetic vectors and actual model/runtime evidence remain separately classified.

### Planned verification

- Run focused diagnostic suites and the required-test coverage gate.
- Review each retained original fault control against a corresponding corrected result without replacing the original evidence.
